data.walmart_policy: Deterministic x=onehot(y,11)+N(0,I) with CPU torch.Generator seed 20260807, matching Table 2.
data.all_other_features: Use the same dataset loaders and fixed split as the main fixed-budget comparison.

sparsification.fixed_self_loops: N fixed singleton self-loops are added outside K for Full, Random-Fixed, and EHGNN-F.
sparsification.Random-Fixed: One uniform exact-K original-incidence mask is sampled per seed and kept fixed throughout training and evaluation.
sparsification.EHGNN-F: Free incidence logits with stochastic exact-K multinomial training and deterministic exact top-K deployment.
sparsification.gradient_estimator: Selected-only straight-through incidence weights routed through the backbone aggregation.

backbone_configuration.AllSetTransformer: PMA attention messages are multiplied by incidence-aligned STE weights after within-target softmax.
backbone_configuration.ED-HNN: Both node-to-edge and edge-to-node means use incidence-aligned STE weighted sums divided by weighted degree.

training.checkpoint: Detached CPU clone; test is evaluated once after restoration.

reporting.summary: mean and sample standard deviation over five model seeds
